map.实际每毫米截点数 nL = 截点数 ÷（图上线长 mm ÷ 放大倍数），即把图上: Actual intercept count per mm nL = intercept count / (measured line length in mm on image / magnification), i.e. converting the measured length on the image back to the true specimen length.
map.ASTM 晶粒度级别 G = −3.2877 + 6.6439·lg(nL)；平: ASTM grain-size number G = -3.2877 + 6.6439 x log(nL); mean intercept length l = 1 / nL, converted to um for comparison with microstructure photos.
map.G 每增加 1 级晶粒数翻倍；多视场取平均并看极差，可判断组织均匀性。: Each increase of 1 in G doubles the grain count; averaging over multiple fields and checking the range indicates microstructure uniformity.

map.测量线总长（图上线长，mm）: Total measured line length (on image, mm)
map.📚 深度解析：金相晶粒度截点法评级: 📚 In-depth: Metallographic Grain-Size Rating by Intercept Method
map.实际每毫米截点数 nL = 截点数 ÷（图上线长 mm ÷ 放大倍数）；晶粒度级: Actual intercept count per mm nL = intercept count / (image line length mm / magnification); grain-size number G = -3.2877 + 6.6439 x log(nL); mean intercept = 1/nL.
map.放大 100×、图上线长 20 mm（实际 0.2 mm），三视场截点 10、1: Magnification 100x, image line length 20 mm (actual 0.2 mm), three fields with intercepts 10, 12, 9 -> nL = 50.0, 60.0, 45.0, G = 8.00, 8.53, 7.70, average 8.07, range 0.83, rated as fine grain.
map.G 值越大晶粒越细吗？: Does a larger G mean finer grains?
map.是。G 每增加 1 级，单位面积晶粒数翻倍，平均截距约缩小到原来的 1/√2。: Yes. Each 1-level increase in G doubles the grain count per unit area, and the mean intercept shrinks to about 1/sqrt(2) of the previous value.
map.单个视场代表性不足，标准建议在多个视场测量后取平均，并用视场间极差评估组织均匀性: A single field is not representative; standards recommend measuring several fields, averaging, and using the inter-field range to assess microstructure uniformity.
